newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mentakab Rubber plans bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Mentakab Rubber plans bonus issue.

text.p: Mentakab Rubber Co (M) Bhd said on Tuesday it is proposing bonus and rights issues.

The oil palm and rubber concern said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange that it also plans to dispose of quoted investments, acquisition of two parcels of land in central Negri Sembilan state as well as the acquisition of 100 percent "in a property development company".
It also said it plans a public issue.
No details were provided on any of the proposed transactions, and Mentakab Rubber said in the statement that it would elaborate "upon finalisation of the proposals".
Shares of Mentakab Rubber have been suspended since April 25 at the company's request. The stock ended at 57 ringgit on that date.
